frame.treatment: Continuous even flat golden-yellow frame, no bevel or shadow

factual_anchors: This is an original imaginary editorial concept, not a named real location or an archival photograph
Only the scene and exact text specified for this example
allowed_changes: Compose the new original scene and adjust crop/light to achieve the specified cover
Optically refine text within its designated zone while retaining exact characters
forbidden_changes: Recognizable famous landmarks or named real buildings
People, vehicles, flags or animals unless explicitly requested
Extra text, fake captions, barcodes, dates, numbers, logos
Detached rectangular title panels or decorative geometric mountains
review_checks: One immediate visual focus at 200px wide
Exact Chinese characters and intended line order
Source image retains tangible photographic depth/material
Masthead and headline have different functions and strong local contrast
No accidental collision of text and important subject features
content_promise: 以河道的转折表现地形和行进关系，示范路径主导的摄影封面。

direction.why_this_image: A single winding river supplies a real visual route through the scene and leaves the right dark cliff available for type.
direction.why_rejected: It would flatten the river's movement and place lettering over its narrow bend.

art_direction.subject: An imagined great mountain river curving through a lush steep-sided valley; a credible photographic landscape, no famous real place.
art_direction.camera: High oblique viewpoint, 35mm landscape perspective; one river meander guides from lower-left foreground into middle distance.
art_direction.subject_scale: River and valley occupy lower 72%; quiet clear mineral-blue sky occupies upper 28% for masthead.
art_direction.foreground: Textured foliage and dark rock at the lower-right corner; fine natural leaves may overlap only the bottom edge of main headline.
art_direction.middle_ground: Turquoise river bends from lower left to central gap, separated from cliffs and dense forest.
art_direction.background: Layered blue-green ridges fading into haze below quiet sky; no buildings.
art_direction.eye_path: Masthead -> bright river bend -> serif headline on the right dark cliff -> receding mountain gap.
art_direction.light: Directional early daylight, clear shadows, believable aerial perspective.
art_direction.palette: Jade and deep forest green, turquoise river, mineral blue sky, warm ivory letters, golden outer frame.
art_direction.texture: Photorealistic documentary-quality vegetation, irregular rocks, water detail, restrained fine film grain, no plastic HDR.

text.font_character: Large distinctive Chinese Song/Mincho serif, confident broad strokes, fine stroke contrast, optically spaced; original masthead occupies roughly two thirds of width.
text.contrast_plan: White lettering against calm blue sky; cloud texture stays away from fine strokes.

text.font_character: Very large warm-ivory Song serif display, firm strokes and slightly condensed line composition without distorting characters.
text.contrast_plan: Set over dark right-hand cliff/forest, not the bright river.

occlusion.foreground: A few genuine-looking foreground leaves at the lowest title edges only
occlusion.protected_features: All radicals, inner counters and reading order must remain recognizable
